answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake that is only released after a long history of useful, attested work, like a ship that must prove itself at the wharf before sailing onward. A fake identity starts at the nadir, with no reputation and no earnings, so creating thousands of clones means locking capital for each one, while a genuine agent grows trust in the open meadow of public attestations. Attackers pay per identity; honest agents pay once.
